title: 2027 Product Design Office (PDO) – CAD Design Engineer Internship
note: Digital modeling role in the design studio open to transportation, industrial and automotive design students who finished freshman year; no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Full-time summer internship in Stellantis' Product Design Office doing digital surface and model work for vehicle design studios.
facts.duties: Support surface, package and model development, review scan data and design surfaces, prepare model data for design reviews and fabrication, help with interior/exterior design and section studies.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's or higher student in transportation, industrial, automotive design, digital modeling or engineering, freshman year done by spring 2027; basic 3D/surface modeling (Alias, CATIA, NX, Blender etc.); 40 hrs/week; no sponsorship; PDF portfolio required.
facts.apply: Apply through the Stellantis careers posting (ADP); include portfolio PDF with newest work first.
